learn.title: Learn Vedic astrology
learn.description: Plain-language articles on Vedic astrology: what kundli terms mean and how they are calculated, each one written and reviewed by a named person.
learn.intro: Articles that explain the ideas behind kundli, panchang, dasha and the free tools on this site in plain language: what a term means, where it comes from in the classical texts, and how the numbers you see are calculated.
standards: Every article names its author and the person who reviewed it, and shows when it was published and last updated. An article is only listed here after that review.

Positions, tithis, nakshatras and dasha periods quoted in an article come from our calculation engine or our published data tables, never from memory. Articles explain and describe; they do not promise outcomes, and astrology is offered for guidance and entertainment.
